_doc: The owner's pipeline-only switch, read once a tick by relentless.py (owner_pause_rule -> owner_pause). pipeline_only true: content_pause reads a global owner pause whatever Operations' verdict or holding, and pause_stops lets start only a pipeline item: one of Operations' system items (ops_health.is_system, the verdict's system_items, fx.first) or an id starting with a pipeline_prefixes entry. An expedite, the priority list, a fresh ruling or a live iteration does not pass content. Running work, checks and the game phase finish; the line walks past held content to the pipeline items behind it; no 6 h pause alarm; staffing does not count held content as ready. Set pipeline_only false (or delete this file) when he lifts it. A file that cannot be read reads as on.
